steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The outlander returns once more to the gate of the Wisteria Pavilion.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: The vermillion gate stands sealed shut, its surface stained with mottled shadows, wilted vines hanging limp in the deathly silence. Amid the bustling fete, this place seems eerily out of place.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: A gentle tap of the gate ring yields no response. Moving closer, the outlander presses an ear against the gate, and, amidst the silence, discerns a faint sound of merriment and laughter, accompanied by hints of an ethereal fragrance.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Filled with a mysterious courage, the outlander pushes open the door, only to be engulfed by a blinding flood of white light...
[White Light Transition]
The white light fades, and you find yourself standing in a courtyard.
Unlike the impression from outside, you see no signs of merriment or revelry.
All that meets the eye is an overgrown field, scattered rocks, and a withered wisteria tree with its truck cut split.

The space appears desolate and devoid of life, completely cut off from the bustle of the festive street outside. Amidst this emptiness, the bare wisteria tree stands alone, leafless and flowerless, yet mysteriously adorned with strange, faded ribbons.
The only reply is silence.
The taleteller, too, offers no response.
You step forward. The withered wisteria tree is the only thing of note in this desolate place.

Respecting the sanctity of the wish tags, you cautiously observe them from a distance. The ink inscriptions on them are either so faded that they are indecipherable or scripted in a language unfamiliar to you.

Perhaps due to the wandering in the festivities, as you gaze at the tree, your thoughts grow heavy with an invisible weight. A mysterious fatigue overtakes you, compelling you to sit against the trunk. Your eyes slowly drift shut.
Time becomes meaningless—perhaps an eternity has passed, or maybe just a fleeting moment. Suddenly, a sweet floral fragrance tickles your nose, gently stirring your drowsy consciousness.
Then something soft brushes against your lips—a touch so fleeting that it vanishes just as quickly as it came.
Finally, you manage to pry your eyes open, only to be greeted with an extraordinary sight—

The withered wisteria has miraculously sprung to life, its branches now laden with cascading purple blooms that sway like ethereal wind chimes. Amidst this lavender sea of flowers reclines a woman, her beguiling smile displaying evident amusement as she observes you.
Oh, my, you were in such a deep slumber. It took a kiss to wake you up.
The memory of that touch on your lips suddenly becomes crystal clear. You instinctively wipe your mouth, which only makes her burst into laughter.
A shy one, aren't you? Getting all flustered over just a little kiss.
Alright, I'll stop teasing you now. It was just a flower petal that kissed your lips.
My health isn't the best, you see. I'm not nimble enough for a kiss-and-run-away.
...She certainly had you fooled there. You compose yourself, dusting off the lingering flower petals before raising your gaze. At last, her face comes into focus—undoubtedly hailing from Eastia.
<size=22>Not nimble, yet a tree climber?</size>
She seems not to catch your muttering. Instead, she stretches lazily and looks down at you, somehow leaning even closer than before.
It's been so long since the flowers last bloomed... Meeting you at just this moment—perhaps it's fate.
May I ask your name, sweetheart?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Just call me ${PlayerName}. And you are?
I am the guardian of this millennium-old wisteria. You may call me <color=#fb9259>Yingying</color>.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: It means a lingering dream that haunts your heart... Keep that in mind, would ya?
You nod, and she responds with a melodious giggle—that same sweet laughter that seems to never leave her lips. Then, she slightly shifts her position, settling into an even more comfortable pose.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Come to think of it, I've never seen anyone dressed quite like you before. That drab gray outfit of yours... Is this some new trend these days?

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Or... have I been brought to some strange place?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Ever heard of it?
She shakes her head.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Mmm... It's pretty far from Eastia.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Eastia? Where's that?

It appears she doesn't know Eastia. You can't help but study her more closely. Her features undeniably bear the mark of Eastian heritage, yet her attire diverges from any Eastians you've encountered—and it hardly looks warm enough...
Could she be one of Yugu's "story characters"? Is this "Yingying," like those peculiar "locals" outside, just another part of this bizarre realm?
As these thoughts cross your mind, she waves her hand with graceful nonchalance, as if accustomed to such scrutiny.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hehe, don't bother. We get all sorts of visitors here, both from near and far lands. I'm quite used to it.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: But what about you? Our fete is all about local traditions, and some of them have been around for ages. Being your first time here, I hope it's not too overwhelming?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I've met others like you before, and I've heard quite a few tales.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But I must say, I was pretty surprised at first... Didn't expect the fete to be run by Eastian "spirits."

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Spirits?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Well, they're nice and all. It's just that they look... different from us, in a fascinating way.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Other than that, everything here is amazing. It's fresh and lively. A unique take on the coziness of local living, I guess.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Hehe, glad to hear you say that.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Everyone here is just lovely and so welcoming. They're all keen to show their hospitality to our guests... Oh, you should check out the underground arena!

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't get me wrong—I'm not asking you to fight with that delicate frame of yours! Just spectating from the sidelines can be quite thrilling!
You notice her eyes light up as she speaks, her genuine joy evident when talking about the local community.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...I wish I could at least offer you a proper cup of tea. Please forgive my lack of hospitality.

steps.speaker: Option
options: No need to be so formal.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm not one for fancy treatment, so don't worry about me. Though... I know a kid who would love to meet you.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: OwO, the girl from Eastia who came with me, would love to hear stories about her homeland. Maybe you could share some with her? You might even get to see her lion dance.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Lion dance?
You notice her eyes light up with interest, but Yingying eventually offers a gentle smile and shakes her head.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I've been sleeping for far too long now, and I can barely move. I wouldn't want to worry the little lady.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Since you're here, might as well make the most of it. Dive into the food, savor the drinks, celebrate the beginning of a new year. That's what this fete is all about.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Just be careful not to wander too far—people tend to lose their way around here. Especially when you have a little one with you. Make sure you don't lose sight of her.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: It's alright, the locals here are good people, I can tell.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: ...Yup.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Here, I have something for you.
She reaches up to pluck a strand of wisteria flowers, and with a magical sleight of hand, produces a pale purple wish tag from her fingertips.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: The millennium-old wisteria is what makes our fete famous. The flowers are known for their mystical powers—they never fail to grant the wishes of those who pray to them.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Think about what you hope for in the coming year, write it down on the tag, and after burning some incense, tie it to a blooming wisteria branch. It's as simple as that.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Though it's still early, the Wisteria Fairy has already taken notice of you. She will remember to read your wish.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: ...My wish...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Don't worry, take your time. It's just for good luck and fun, after all.
As she speaks, she lets out a gentle yawn.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Yaaa—wn... Oh dear, I've finally met a new friend, and here I am getting sleepy again... I must rest now...

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: I'm sorry, sweetheart, but I won't be able to see you out. Can you find your way to the gate yourself? Or shall I have someone escort you?

steps.speaker: Option
options: I can manage on my own.

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Oh, right—someone told me that I should talk with you more. Would it be alright if I visit you again?
She gazes at you for a long moment before a smile finally appears on her face.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: If you wish, my dear. If... that's your wish.
She points to your chest, exactly where you've placed the wish tag.

steps.speaker: Yingying
steps.content: Have a good new year. Bye-bye!

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Bye.
...Wait, do Eastians say "bye-bye" too?
[Scene Change]

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: When consciousness reawakens, the wisteria tree has vanished from sight, and the outlander is once again outside the building.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 The gate now stands locked tight, unmovable, as though all that transpired earlier was but a mere dream.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Yet beneath the eaves, withered vines have turned verdant, and flower petals drift through the air, an entirely different sight from what it once was. The intoxicating fragrance lingers, leaving you in a momentary daze.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Could it be that you're still savoring that mystical encounter, dwelling on thoughts of the enchanting wisteria fairy?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: I'm just a bit surprised...

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: Is that all I get to see of your story's heroine?

steps.speaker: %u
steps.content: But... is that all I get to see of your story's heroine?

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Heh heh, let destiny unfold as it will. When the right moment arises, what is destined for you will naturally find its way.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: It is not yet time to revisit her. Let her rest for now.　　　　　　　　　　　　　　　 In the meantime, you may venture forth and gather intriguing tales from the fete to share with her when your paths cross once more.

steps.speaker: Taleteller's Narration
steps.content: Rest assured, she too eagerly awaits your next encounter.
